# Daksha Foods

> Daksha Foods (https://www.dakshafoods.in) is an artisanal Indian food brand based in Nuzvidu, Eluru, Andhra Pradesh. We specialize in handcrafted cashew cookies, nutrient-rich millets, authentic ragi malt powder, and heritage wellness snacks made with traditional recipes and 100% natural, wholesome ingredients.

## Core Offerings
- Handcrafted Artisanal Cookies (Cashew Cookies, Millet Cookies)
- Heritage Millet Powders (Nutrient-rich Ragi Malt, Organic Millets)
- Traditional Andhra Pradesh Gourmet Savories & Sweets
- Bulk Orders, Corporate Gifting & Wedding Celebration Hampers

## Key Information
- Official Website: https://www.dakshafoods.in
- Storefront Catalog: https://www.dakshafoods.in/products
